messages: devon: Heads-up: during an oncall handover I noticed links in /kb/runbooks/model-onboarding point to fragment IDs that 404 in the latest deploy. Reporting because the runbook is used in incident drills. Anyone own that doc? priya: thanks for flagging. Which fragments? I saw a note yesterday about the 'kv-cache' anchor being renamed. devon: the section reference `#kv-cache-tuning` is redirected to `#kv-cache-config` which the site currently doesn't resolve, so the in-page nav jumps to top. Repro: open the runbook, click the "tuning" link in the table of contents. oncall-bot: Incident drill reminder: please avoid manual edits during active drills. If this is blocking a drill, escalate to eng-oncall. priya: ok. low-risk patch: add a short alias anchor near the new heading so both links work, and add a small note in the runbook changelog. I'll open a micro PR. devon: alias anchor sounds good. Also would be great to add a smoke test that verifies internal fragment links resolve. Maybe a tiny puppeteer check in docs CI that clicks the TOC and expects non-empty content. triage-bot: label applied: docs/quick. assignee: priya. priya: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4899 title: "docs(runbook): add alias anchor for kv-cache-tuning + smoke test note" description: adds `` before the new heading and a follow-up ticket for a lightlink smoke test. sam: quick review: adding an empty anchor is fine but prefer an HTML comment explaining why, e.g. `` so future editors don't remove it. priya: good call, added the comment. PR ready for review. devon: will review in ~10m and check staging preview. If preview shows TOC navigation fixed, I'll approve. docs-bot: PR merged by devon : https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4899 deployed to staging. priya: verified staging: clicking the old TOC link jumps to the aliased anchor and content renders. Created follow-up issue: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/issues/1420 "docs(ci): add TOC fragment smoke test". Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
